experimental_interpretation.note: Effective PSD and local concentration are inferred as optical-volume ensemble properties under continuous stirring.

geometry_provenance.paper_conflict_note: Section 5.3 prose states 3 mm through / 10 mm depth; Fig.3, Fig.4 machining caption and Fig.6 state 4 mm through / 8 mm depth. V24.4 defaults to drawing/machining values.

geometry_provenance.source_launch_note: The paper defines the ring bore but does not locate the LED die/luminous plane within the module. V24.4 defaults the launch reference to the ring outer face and exposes it as a configurable parameter.
